verdict.rationale: Cline's docs say it uses external tools and data sources through MCP servers. The GitHub README says its native app lets users manage MCP servers, and the auto-approve docs list MCP tools as actions Cline can take, which covers both plugging servers in and using their tools. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how servers are added and configured (config format, supported transports, local vs remote servers), and independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP tool use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets Cline use external tools and data sources through MCP servers.
manage models, plugins, and MCP servers
Cline auto-approves everything: file changes, terminal commands, browser actions, MCP tools, and mode transitions.
